name: Minimum usable width
threshold: 180 m inward-buffer core; 2A/P published as audit comparator only

name: Distance to grid data
source: LINZ Topo50 powerlines and road-centreline proxy; any layer carrying a voltage attribute is tiered
threshold: Per-voltage-tier nearest distances in metres; one implementation in grid_distance.verify_grid_flag flags on connection-tier distance against that tier's review_distance_m (grid_distance_review_m only where the layer carries no voltage attribute); unknown distance also flags; rank_shift is published but never triggers; excluded from screen_score

name: Mean annual solar radiation
threshold: Higher is better; weighted screen_score_weights.solar_resource in review ordering

name: Mean slope
source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM sampled per site by scripts/compute_site_terrain.py
threshold: Mean slope over the polygon above maximum_mean_slope_deg; a site with no slope value is not excluded and raises S08_verify_slope instead

name: Mapped water or wetland
threshold: Any intersection with mapped standing water or wetland

name: Coastal hazard proximity
threshold: Within coastal_review_distance_m of the open coast
